artboards.title: Measure — one photo on its own
Table — every photo as a row
First run — nothing set up yet

annotations.text:
THE SHELL — DIRECTION A + C'S RAIL

One window, six regions, nothing scrolls but the photo list and the table:

· section rail — MEASURE / TABLE / RESULTS, with the account at its foot
· title bar — wordmark, sync status, Sync
· context bar — camera, flag photo, FOLDER PICKER, method, Measure all
· photo list · frame · measurement
· status bar — models, device, or the run's progress

The rail replaced the top tabs: two navigations for the same three sections is one too many. Drawn at 1440 x 900; every pane is fluid, so a maximised window gives the frame the extra width.

PER-PHOTO MEASURE

Two ways in, both on this artboard: the Measure button on the list row itself, and the big one in the panel when an unmeasured photo is selected. The panel spells out what it will use — this camera, this flag photo, this method — so a single photo is never measured against something you did not expect.

WHOLE FOLDER RUNNING

The status bar becomes the run: a hairline progress line, the photo in flight, counts and time left, and Measure all turns into Stop. Rows tick over to a number as each finishes, so you can start reviewing the early ones while the rest run.

TABLE — DIRECTION C'S GRID, IN A'S SHELL

The third section. Every photo is a row: file, time, species, distance, 90% interval, confidence, alignment, status. Headings sort; the chips and the search box filter.

Two things the Measure tab cannot do:
· tick many rows and measure just those (the amber bar at the top)
· compare numbers down a column — an alignment score or a confidence that is out of line with its neighbours shows up instantly

The preview stays on the right so a row is still one click from the photo it came from, and 'Open in Measure' hands it to the big viewer.

DECIDED

A is the shell. From C: the data grid became the TABLE section, and the left icon rail became the app's navigation — both in A's graphite and amber rather than C's lime. B is kept here as the record of what was not taken.
